Subject: Discovery follow-up: Demo & tech deep dive — scheduling

Hi Alex / Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful conversation. Quick recap from our call and next steps: 

- Primary goal: reduce query latency for customer-facing search and cut token costs on long-form generation pipelines.
- Key success metrics: p95 latency < 300ms, 30% reduction in per-token infra spend for inference.
- Technical constraints: on-prem database, SSO/SCIM requirement, need for audit logs and data retention controls.

Next step: schedule a demo + technical deep dive where Camila (solutions engineer) can walk through architecture and run through integration considerations. Proposed times (PT):

1) Tue May 19 — 10:00 AM PT
2) Wed May 20 — 11:00 AM PT
3) Thu May 21 — 2:00 PM PT

Can you confirm which slot works and who will join from your side (dev / infra / security)? Once you confirm I’ll send a calendar invite with the Zoom link and attach a short agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
A: +1 (415) 555-0192
